authorization: 2026-09-05 isolated-copy repair, structural adaptation and evaluator integration; original model/scripts/Wiki/form preserved
scope: New standardized computational model, NOT reconstruction of the historical fermentation model

new_operational_decisions.medium: All source Yeast-GEM exchange bounds retained exactly; glucose uptake limit 1, ethanol uptake closed, oxygen uptake limit 1000. All original maintenance bounds retained. Complete bounds exported.
new_operational_decisions.experimental_product_rate: Not imposed as constraint or used to tune thresholds; 0.000193873 is a historical record only.
new_operational_decisions.growth_reference: Maximum r_2111 flux of the unmodified-genotype NEW common model, same medium. All 0.1/0.5/0.9 floors use this single WT denominator.
new_operational_decisions.candidate_pool: Native genes with a nonempty effective GPR knockout footprint; exclude any footprint containing boundary, transport, biomass or maintenance; at least one affected internal reaction must be FVA-unblocked at WT growth floor 0.1; mutant must retain >=0.1 WT maximum growth. Include complete gene knockout footprint in evaluation.
new_operational_decisions.blocked_definition: FVA minimum and maximum within +/-1e-7, under common medium and 0.1 WT growth floor; never one arbitrary FBA solution.
new_operational_decisions.fastknock_mapping: Native K=1 tree construction on reaction representatives with exact single-gene GPR footprint as co-knockout set; only root-active admissible actions traversed, per native target-space rule. Deduplicate identical gene footprints. Keep root solutions.
new_operational_decisions.fastknock_objective: Native biomass-maximizing FBA. No lexicographic product maximization substituted into search. Independent evaluator recalculates all product bounds.
new_operational_decisions.cfsa_mapping: Native three-scenario OptGP, common model at 0.1 WT growth floor. Source functions with compatibility/seed/checkpoint patches only. Original 10000 samples, thinning 100, optimality .9, pFBA flux multiplier 1.25 retained; one process.
new_operational_decisions.cfsa_gene_translation: Only native knock-out recommendations mapped to eligible genes whose Boolean GPR knockout actually disables the recommended reaction. KD and over-expression kept separately; not silently converted to KO.
new_operational_decisions.cfsa_rank: Descending mean_absolute_change (source filtering notebook), descending min(KS1v3, KS2v3), gene ID for ties; highest scoring supported reaction per gene.
new_operational_decisions.independent_evaluator: Reload canonical model, apply actual gene.knock_out(), verify footprint; solve maximum growth, and min/max product under each ABSOLUTE WT growth floor; separately min/max product at >=0.95 mutant maximum growth. Preserve solver status and feasibility residual.
new_operational_decisions.independent_ranking: Report native order and all metrics; no post-hoc scalar aggregate tuned on results.
new_operational_decisions.cfsa_validation: Report valid sample counts, maximal stoichiometric/bound residual and source Geweke scores. One seeded chain does not establish full mixing; no ranking validated solely by sample count.
new_operational_decisions.time_budget: 3600 wall seconds per native method invocation including its method-specific preparation; shared model/candidate preparation and independent evaluation timed separately; timeout retains partial files, never counts as zero candidates.
new_operational_decisions.round1: Do not load held-out Round 1 values, validation reports, or outcomes.

modeling_assumptions.decision: r_4780 uses lumped net aerobic disposal: phytoene + 2 O2 -> lycopene + 4 H2O. Enzyme-bound FAD cancels. No NAD(P)H/ATP recovery from carotene desaturation.
modeling_assumptions.evidence: EC1.3.99.31 specifies four electron-acceptor reductions; Schaub 2012 establishes enzyme-bound FAD and oxygen terminal acceptor.
modeling_assumptions.boundary: Water disposal is an explicit steady-state composite model assumption, NOT a measured elementary CrtI stoichiometry. Schaub reports unresolved oxygen intermediates; no claim that CrtI directly produces water.

modeling_assumptions.decision: Hydroxylation uses one NADPH + H+ per added hydroxyl; ketolation uses two NADPH + 2H+ and two O2 per introduced keto group, with three water products.
modeling_assumptions.evidence: EC1.14.99.63/.64 specify two reduced acceptors per keto group; EC1.14.15.24 describes ferredoxin-mediated hydroxylation.
modeling_assumptions.boundary: NADPH is a declared lumped upstream electron-supply convention, retaining the archived hydroxylation donor. Direct donor/reductase identity in the project construct has not been measured; no invented gene for this coupling.

modeling_assumptions.decision: Carotenoid reactions cytosolic; product transport/export are bookkeeping drains. Native and heterologous import bounds are not opened.
modeling_assumptions.boundary: No claim of measured secretion or transporter activity.

modeling_assumptions.decision: Import only metabolites used by the 21 astaxanthin reactions; omit unused beta-carotene[e] and two indigoidine records.
modeling_assumptions.boundary: The archived indigoidine compartment conflict remains documented in the untouched original package; it is not part of this astaxanthin model.
